description: Use this when you need to know where and why a design breaks across a tolerance/dimension range, not just whether it builds at one nominal value. Declares one or more param() names with a { values: [...] } list or a { min, max, steps } range (number params are bisected; choice/string params are evaluated as discrete points), re-evaluates the script once per cartesian-product combination (capped at 64 combos — exceeding it truncates to the first 64 and emits kinematic.sweep-tolerance.combo-cap-exceeded), and measures every requirement in the S2 ledger (script require(), dfmSpec, gated FEA, mechanical intent) plus the standard gates on each combo: interference, mounting-hole diameter agreement, and joint-axis binding (all three default on); reachability only when gates.reachable names a tip_link + target. After the coarse grid it bisects each numeric pass/fail transition down to boundaryTolerance and reports the boundary value, the failing side, and the binding requirement/gate names (e.g. "wall fails below 1.840 mm; binding: wall"). Returns per-combo verdicts, firstFailure per gate, firstRequirementFailure per requirement, boundaries[], and a coverage statement that says "checked at N points plus boundaries", never "proven".

assembly.description: Assembly name; defaults to the first captured assembly.

boundaryBudget.description: Maximum extra evaluations spent bisecting boundaries. Default 64; 0 skips bisection.

boundaryTolerance.description: Absolute parameter tolerance for boundary bisection. Default 0.001.

file.description: Path to a .kcad.ts script file. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

gates.description: Which standard gates to run per combo.

reachable.description: Runs the reachability gate when set.

params.description: param() name -> { values: [number|string, ...] } or { min, max, steps }.
